data_dictionary.none_state: NONE means the strategic base is destroyed or demolished and has not been rebuilt by either faction; it is effectively no-man's-land.
data_dictionary.rate_trends: Adjacent equal-window comparison. Array order is [recent_per_hour, previous_per_hour, change_per_hour, direction].
data_dictionary.recent_events: A direct ownership flip can produce a loss row plus a capture row for the same state transition.
data_dictionary.selected_metrics: Evidence citation keys whose values and observation times are frozen at prediction time.
data_dictionary.total_enlistments: Cumulative unique players who have deployed to this region during the war. A player can count in multiple regions. This is not current population or a faction split; its change is only a new-to-that-region activity proxy.

previous_model_summary.headline: Weathered Expanse Leads Renewed Fighting; Fisherman’s Row Resumes
previous_model_summary.war_summary: Since the last edition, Weathered Expanse has become the busiest front, recording nine strategic-base events in the latest two hours and eighteen in the past day; Necropolis, Spirit Watch, and Wightwalk lead the list of contested positions. Fisherman’s Row, quiet in the previous two-hour ledger, has resumed with two fresh events and a day total of thirty-three, with Arcadia and Peripti Landing again drawing the heaviest activity. Godcrofts shows five events in two hours, at Exile and Lipsia, while Lykos Isle adds three more to a twenty-one-event day. Oarbreaker reports three fresh events and Stlican Shelf two, holding to the island-and-shelf pattern seen earlier. Tempest Island’s flurry has faded, with no events in the latest two hours, and DeadLands has not produced new flips since earlier. Weathered Expanse’s daily casualty count remains enormous, topping twenty-two thousand Warden and eighteen thousand Colonial losses. The war, in its 128th day, still has no declared victor.
